decision.meaning: The dedicated down-stream entry computes correct output for a real GGUF IQ3_S ffn_down_exps row slice, compared to CPU to_float reference. This strengthens real-layout evidence but does not prove full-model correctness or performance.
limitations: Only expert0 first 16 rows of blk.0.ffn_down_exps.weight were tested.
The source GGUF was previously rejected as a full model, so this is tensor-layout evidence only.
No full model token generation, prompt-general benchmark, TTFT, or 16GB model-run gate was executed.
decision.next_step: Extend real-row parity to the exact compact target types needed for a viable model, or run strict load/correctness for one compact target after disk cleanup approval.
